audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were marked K'Sante while their whys say 'Level 2 stays even' and 'Level 3 remains a skill matchup'. Separately, the whole page tracks an ability called simply 'Ultimate' — a placeholder, not a name.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante, which matches the whys. Zaahen's real ultimate is Grim Deliverance, 110/95/80s, and it heals him for a portion of the damage dealt — that is the cooldown worth tracking.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 set to Skill; the tracked ability is named Grim Deliverance with its 110s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had only 3 entries — the inherited structural gap the packet flags — and none of the three carried a cooldown or an ability name.
audit.why: Zaahen's passive is the missing spike: 'When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.' A full-build revive changes every all-in decision and was nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] created with the Determination revive; the existing three now carry Grim Deliverance's 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Zaahen ability was named, and four flagged interactions were absent: his Q heals and is an auto-attack reset with a knockup recast, his E is percent-health, his R heals, and both sides carry displacement.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s) 'slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself' and can be recast to knock up. Dreaded Return (W, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, 850 range) stabs then pulls. Aureate Rush (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) dashes and carries the percentHealth flag. Grim Deliverance (R) heals for a portion of damage dealt.
audit.corrected: Names and cooldowns are now in whys, spikes, early and mid; the attack-reset tell and the anti-heal requirement are stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The item line carried no anti-heal despite Zaahen healing off both Q and R.
audit.why: Two of his four active abilities heal; the missing-interactions file flags Grievous Wounds timing as decisive in extended trades here.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to the itemization line and to the first-item all-in rule.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the Q-slow engine), then Sunfire Aegis / Kaenic Rookern; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Sunfire Aegis; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add Grievous Wounds early — his Q and R both heal.

edits.before: - Zaahen Ultimate: matchup-defining — His big cooldown. Trade around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Zaahen Grim Deliverance: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1 and it heals him. Trade around it, with anti-heal up. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Zaahen's Ultimate: His big cooldown. Trade around it. When it is down — Q3-R him.
edits.after: Track Grim Deliverance: 110s at rank 1, and it heals him. When it is down — Ntofo-pull and R him.

edits.before: Level 2 stays even: his Q range and your W's damage reduction cancel out in short trades.
edits.after: Level 2 stays even: The Darkin Glaive's heal and your W's damage reduction cancel in short trades.

edits.before: Level 3 remains a skill matchup — your stun potential offsets his poke advantage.
edits.after: Level 3 stays a skill matchup — your stun offsets Aureate Rush's percent-health slice.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still a wash as you both scale and neither can hard-commit safely.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay a wash — his Q knockup recast trades evenly with your W stun.

edits.before: At first item you spike hard — All Out's shred plus your stun combo out-duels him.
edits.after: At first item you spike — All Out plus the stun chain out-duels him if his R is down.

edits.before: All Out arrives — the stage still reads even, but the all-in threat is now yours to time.
edits.after: All Out arrives — the stage reads even, but with his R on 110s the all-in threat is yours to time.

edits.before: The real spike: All Out's shred plus the Q-W stun combo wins committed duels — start forcing them.
edits.after: The real spike: All Out plus the Q-W stun chain wins duels — force them while Grim Deliverance is down.
Full Determination lets him revive once with bonus AD — hold Grievous Wounds and your R until that revive has been spent.

edits.before: Patience lane: nothing through level 5 is owed to either of you — his Q range pokes, your Path Maker's damage reduction and stun threat answer it, and short trades cancel out. Farm cleanly, keep Ntofo Strikes charged on the wave so the stun is always loaded, and do not chase kills that are not scripted yet.
edits.after: Patience lane: nothing through level 5 is owed to either of you — The Darkin Glaive resets his auto and heals him, your Path Maker's damage reduction and stun answer it, and short trades cancel out. Watch his auto wind-up, not the cast. Farm cleanly, keep Ntofo Strikes stacked so the pull is loaded, and chase nothing unscripted.

edits.before: Level 6 reads even on paper, but the tension has picked a side: All Out makes the committed all-in your button to press. At first item, press it — the resist shred plus the Q-W stun chain out-duels his bruiser stats, and a fight he takes at full commitment is a fight he loses.
edits.after: Level 6 reads even on paper, but the tension has picked a side: All Out makes the committed all-in your button. At first item, press it — with Grievous Wounds up and only once Grim Deliverance, 110s at rank 1, has been spent, since his R heals him out of a fight he should lose.
